entries.why_here: They need living sacrifices to call a more powerful demon.
entries.description: Chanting rolls through the fungus. A scarred blood mage leads three tormentors. They've been looking for someone exactly like you.
entries.tactics: Spells (harm, grim tendrils, ray of enfeeblement), Wicked Bite. They try to take a hero alive.
entries.lore_hook: Their rite at I35 is meant to summon a greater demon. Whether it works is the GM's call.

entries.title: Wisps Desperate to Feed
entries.book_source: I61-I64 (the Lady's Whisper commands many dread wisps; one 'desperate to feed for the first time in many years')
entries.why_here: The Lady's Whisper's wisps roam the Gauntlight's depths.
entries.description: A bruise-colored light hangs in the dark ahead, pulsing hungrily.
entries.tactics: Draining, wearying touch, and Feed on Despair.
entries.lore_hook: They serve the Lady's Whisper, a unique undead tied to Nhimbaloth.

entries.title: A Bright Walker Gets Loose
entries.book_source: I24 (two Bright Walkers, rare undead caligni, kept calm only by Galudu)
entries.why_here: When Galudu is away, the restless walkers drift out of the lodge.
entries.description: A burning figure walks an inch above the ground, radiant and furious, lighting the fungus forest gold.
entries.tactics: Radiant touch and ray (fire, light). Landbound. It assumes any non-caligni means the lodge is under attack.
entries.lore_hook: Galudu can calm it. Bring her or say her name (DC 26 Diplomacy).

entries.title: Remains on the Trail
entries.book_source: I48 (bones and viscera from the gogiteth's feeding; it sometimes lurks in the passage to ambush)
entries.why_here: It lurks along its feeding trail.
entries.description: Bones and torn viscera are strewn across the cave as if a battle just ended. Then something many-legged drops the urdefhan corpse it was eating.
entries.tactics: Its jaws give Improved Grab, and Carry Off Prey drags a victim away. Deadly.
entries.lore_hook: Even the black dragon Ravirex learned to avoid this thing.

entries.title: Reaper-Skull Puffballs
entries.book_source: I32 (two puffballs)
entries.why_here: Puffballs grow throughout the fungus forests.
entries.description: A puffball with a skull-shaped cap turns toward you, and tendrils uncurl from its base.
entries.tactics: Paralyzing tendrils and a spore cloud (DC 28 basic Fortitude, 4d8 poison).
entries.lore_hook: Drow hunters avoid this patch. That's why it's untouched.

entries.title: Something in the Fog
entries.book_source: I31 (a derghodaemon in the Demonic Fog, guarding the urdefhan's hunting grounds; it scuttles out when it hears intruders)
entries.why_here: Noise carries to the fog bank at the south end.
entries.description: A fog bank rolls out of the south cave, and inside it something with too many arms clicks and scuttles toward the noise.
entries.tactics: Claws, swarm spit and divine spells. Its fog's mouths drain life. Deadly.
entries.lore_hook: It's one of the two things blocking the caligni's escape routes.

entries.title: The Ribbon at Full Strength
entries.book_source: I28 (ribbon: 9d6 negative, DC 24 basic Reflex)
entries.why_here: This deep, the Gauntlight's ribbons are lethal.
entries.description: A 5-foot burst of churning, colorless light hums like a struck bell.
entries.immediate_action: A living creature ending its turn in it takes 9d6 negative damage (DC 24 basic Reflex). Find a way around it.
entries.success: You get around it.
entries.failure: 9d6 negative damage. Undead in it heal by that much.

entries.title: The Crystals Ring
entries.book_source: I40 (pale green crystals that ring in a chain reaction when touched, drawing the predator nesting at I41)
entries.why_here: Crystal growths throughout the cavern carry sound a long way.
entries.description: Someone brushes a hanging strand of pale green crystal. It rings, and the next one rings, and the next, until the whole shore is singing.
entries.immediate_action: DC 26 Acrobatics or Thievery to still the crystals before the chain carries.
entries.success: Silence. Nothing heard.
entries.failure: Every predator on the lake heard that: ADD 1 DIE TO JAR, and the next COMBAT roll arrives in 2 rounds.

entries.title: A Thousand Bats
entries.book_source: I42 (hundreds of tiny subterranean bats that swarm heads; they're food for larger creatures)
entries.why_here: The bats hunt across the Hunting Grounds, and larger things hunt the bats.
entries.description: Hundreds of tiny bats pour out of a cave and swarm around your heads, harmless and deafening.
entries.immediate_action: DC 26 Stealth to stay put and let them pass, or DC 26 Nature to read where they're fleeing from.
entries.success: You learn which direction the danger is: REMOVE 1 DIE FROM JAR by avoiding it.
entries.failure: Whatever hunts the bats is now following them, toward you.

10.name: To Draw the Baleful Glare (The Empty Vault)
10.ecology: The ancient temple of Nhimbaloth at the bottom of everything. The dead cult's initiates linger as specters. Dread wisps, the 'soul feeders', funnel souls toward the Empty Vault. Void-touched chuuls and an isqulug infestation lurk in the reeds and swamp, and the Outer God's attention presses on anyone carrying a lens. Bound elementals, golems and traps guard the portal chambers.

entries.title: Soul Feeders
entries.book_source: J8 (three dread wisps, 'soul feeders', funneling souls into the Empty Vault); J1-J4 (the Lady's Whisper's shadowing wisps)
entries.why_here: The soul feeders can't return to the Empty Vault without more souls, and you have souls.
entries.description: Bruise-colored lights rise from the floor in silence and drift toward you like moths to a flame. You feel your soul lean toward them.
entries.tactics: Draining, wearying touch, and Feed on Despair. They focus whoever is most despairing.
entries.lore_hook: Souls released here flow into the Empty Vault (J20), where Belcorra waits.

entries.title: Cultists Who Failed the Test
entries.book_source: J2 (six cultist specters with ghostly blowguns of ethereal darts; they pass through walls to keep their distance)
entries.why_here: Nhimbaloth's long-dead initiates still haunt the temple's galleries.
entries.description: Robed figures seep out of the walls with blowguns raised and fire darts made of their own ghostly substance.
entries.tactics: Ranged ethereal darts and vile touch (Spectral Corruption). They pass through walls to keep their distance.
entries.lore_hook: They failed the Lady's Whisper's initiation. Its trial is still running.

entries.title: Void-Touched Chuuls
entries.book_source: J15 (three chuuls imbued with Void Bracken's vile energy, in the toxic swamp)
entries.why_here: The temple swamp's void-touched chuuls hunt beyond it.
entries.description: A chuul with a shell veined in lightless black rises from fetid water, and its tentacles drip something worse than poison.
entries.tactics: Claws to Grab, then draining venom (DC 28 Fortitude). They fight until destroyed.
entries.lore_hook: Nhimbaloth's touch has warped even the Darklands' predators.

entries.title: The Reeds Writhe
entries.book_source: J17 (an 'isalo' infestation: a grotesque aberration in the reeds whose larvae came here ages ago; flagged F1, matched to the isqulug)
entries.why_here: It's malevolent but has nothing to do with Nhimbaloth. It's just here, and hungry.
entries.description: The reeds ahead writhe, and something huge and many-tentacled heaves itself out of them.
entries.tactics: Its tentacles inflict isqulugia (larval infestation). Primal spells: entangle, control water.
entries.lore_hook: It remembers little about how its larvae came here. The book's caption calls it an 'isalo' (floor doc flag F1).

entries.title: Those Who Glimpsed the Empty Death
entries.book_source: H21 (Children who studied Nhimbaloth's lore were blasted by glimpses of the Outer God and became bodaks); J20 (Nhimbaloth's attention)
entries.why_here: Anyone who looks too closely at Nhimbaloth here risks becoming one of these.
entries.description: Gray, hairless figures with empty eye sockets turn toward you, and their gaze is death.
entries.tactics: Death Gaze. Bodak Spawn: humanoids who die while drained or doomed by one rise as bodaks.
entries.lore_hook: This is what Nhimbaloth's uncaring gaze does to mortals.

entries.title: Eyes of Nhimbaloth
entries.book_source: Nhimbaloth's wisps throughout the Vaults (D9, G12, H2); the Empty Vault feeds them
entries.why_here: The temple of the Empty Death draws wisps the way a lighthouse draws moths.
entries.description: A constellation of blue lights opens in the dark like eyes, all at once.
entries.tactics: Feed on Fear. Individually weak at this depth; dangerous in numbers.
entries.lore_hook: Wisps are Nhimbaloth's eyes. You're being watched.

entries.title: The Baleful Glare
entries.book_source: Floor 8 background (the fulcrum lenses invite Nhimbaloth's uncaring gaze); J11 and J12 (Images of Failure and Powerlessness, level 12)
entries.why_here: Down here, Nhimbaloth's attention is close, and it presses hardest on anyone carrying a lens.
entries.description: The dark ahead becomes an eye, vast and indifferent. For a moment you see yourself the way it does: small, failed, already forgotten.
entries.immediate_action: Each hero: DC 30 Will. Lens-bearers roll twice and take the worse result. Averting your gaze gives +1 to the save.
entries.success: You hold onto yourself.
entries.failure: Stupefied 1 for 1 hour (stupefied 2 on a critical failure).

entries.title: Heat From the Elemental Pools
entries.book_source: J6 (extremely hot: 2d6 fire every 10 minutes; magma 20d6 per round)
entries.why_here: Bound fire elementals have kept the magma pools hot for centuries, and the heat leaks.
entries.description: The corridor walls are hot to the touch, and the air shimmers with the glow of magma somewhere close.
entries.immediate_action: Push straight through (2d6 fire) or detour.
entries.success: You detour: ADD 1 DIE TO JAR, no damage.
entries.failure: 2d6 fire per hero, and someone brushes a wall: their gear starts smoking.

entries.title: Shards Underfoot
entries.book_source: J8 (5 piercing per Stride barefoot; Stolen Soul)
entries.why_here: The soul feeders' room is carpeted in shards, and they've spread.
entries.description: The floor glitters with dark shards that seem to drink the light, and maybe more than light.
entries.immediate_action: DC 27 Perception to pick a safe path, or DC 27 Occultism to recognize what the shards hold.
entries.success: Safe passage, and you know to keep the shards away from the dead.
entries.failure: 5 piercing damage per Stride for anyone not well shod. GM: see J8's Stolen Soul.

entries.title: Toxic Water
entries.book_source: J15 (toxic swamp)
entries.why_here: The temple's swamp water is poisoned by the void.
entries.description: Black water pools across the passage. It smells like nothing at all, which is somehow worse.
entries.immediate_action: Wade, or find a way over (DC 27 Athletics or Acrobatics).
entries.success: You stay dry.
entries.failure: Wading: DC 27 Fortitude or 4d6 poison and sickened 1.

entries.title: The Comforting Voice
entries.book_source: I62 and J1-J4 (the Lady's Whisper comforted the fearful with lies about 'resting and departing in peace' before feeding them to the sunless garden)
entries.why_here: The Lady's Whisper speaks to the weary down here.
entries.description: A gentle voice, very close, tells you you've done enough. You could rest. You could simply put it all down.
entries.immediate_action: DC 30 Will, or DC 30 Perception to notice the voice comes from nowhere.
entries.success: You recognize the lie. You know the Lady's Whisper is near and testing you.
entries.failure: You sit, just for a moment: ADD 1 DIE TO JAR, and you're fatigued until your next rest.
